prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Archetype & Voice", "Select a distinct personality trait and voice style for your desktop companion.", "Playful / Calm / Curious"]
1: ["Name Your New Companion", "Give your pet a custom name to generate its official digital desktop adoption certificate.", "Generate Certificate", "Companion Name"]
2: ["Guided Pet Photo Studio", "Follow these 3 simple photo checks to ensure perfect 3D rendering of your custom pet.", "Frontal view with clear lighting", "Upload Clear Photo"]
3: ["Save Your Pet to Cloud Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet's appearance, personality, and memories."]
4: ["Cloud Sync Guarantee: Signing in links your pet ID so your pet is never lost or reset after app updates or restarts."]
5: ["Explore Desktop Companion Styles", "Swipe to preview custom pet paths and pick the experience that fits your workspace."]
6: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "Creating 3D models and desktop interaction physics.", "Generating 3D Mesh & Animations..."]
7: ["Welcome Pack Unlocked!", "Your companion is ready on your desktop with 3 free starter items in your inventory.", "Bonus: 3 Starter Items Claimed"]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom right corner of your primary screen or taskbar tray to talk to or summon your pet anytime.", "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to center your pet on screen."]
9: ["Unsure which path to pick? Click 'Quick Match' to find your ideal companion in 2 questions.", "Take 5-Sec Path Quiz"]
